title: BCIAUT-P300 dataset for autism from Simoes et al 2020
description: EEG dataset from 15 adolescents and adults with autism spectrum disorder who took part in a P300-based brain-computer interface joint-attention training in a virtual environment. Each participant completed 7 sessions in which 8 flashing objects served as targets or non-targets, with EEG recorded from 8 channels at 250 Hz. The data are epoched and preprocessed, and are provided as a benchmark for P300 classification within-subject, cross-session and cross-subject.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a wireless g.Nautilus system (g.tec) from 8 channels (C3, Cz, C4, CPz, P3, Pz, P4, POz) at 250 Hz, referenced to the right ear with AFz as ground. Participants performed a visual P300 joint-attention task in a virtual environment with 8 flashing objects over 7 sessions, with 2 runs per session. Each session had 1600 calibration trials plus online test trials. Data were bandpass filtered at 2-30 Hz and epoched over 0-1.2 s.
